label: Сон
description: A 10-sentence usage card for сон (sleep; dream).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Сон' is the masculine nominative subject after 'был'. 'Странный' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'у меня' shows whose dream it was.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Сон' is the accusative direct object of 'видел'. For this inanimate masculine noun the accusative matches the nominative. 'Странный' agrees with it.
Strategic focus: Genitive with fleeting vowel. 'Сна' is the genitive after 'от'; the vowel 'о' drops out of the stem. 'Страшного' agrees in the masculine genitive and 'ребёнок' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Сну' is the dative form, the thing helped, governed by 'помогает'. The fleeting 'о' drops, and 'крепкому' agrees in the masculine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after verb. 'Сном' is instrumental because 'наслаждаться' governs the instrumental case. The fleeting 'о' drops, and 'спокойным' agrees in the masculine instrumental.

missions.phrase: Во сне я летал над городом.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'Во сне' uses the prepositional form 'сне' after 'во' to mean in a dream. The fleeting 'о' drops, and 'я' is the subject of 'летал'.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Сон' is the masculine nominative subject. 'Здоровый' is the agreeing adjective and 'важен' is the short-form predicate adjective describing it.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Сны' is the nominative plural subject of 'снятся', which agrees in the plural. 'Плохие' agrees and 'мне' is the dative experiencer.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural object. 'Снов' is the genitive plural after the negated 'не помню'. 'Своих' agrees in the genitive plural, and 'я' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Сон' is the accusative after 'в', expressing falling into sleep. 'Глубокий' agrees and 'бабушка' is the nominative subject of 'погрузилась'.
